scalars.scalar_value: A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with major course work preferably in business, communications, marketing, broadcast and/or journalism.

Three (3) years of increasingly responsible experience in public media, broadcasting, television, radio, digital media, production, station operations, or a closely related field, including at least one (1) year of lead, supervisory, administrative, or program coordination responsibility.

items.item_text: 01. Which option below best describes your highest level of education? (NOTE: For positions requiring college units/degree, a copy of the transcript must be included as an attachment. The transcript must be legible from an accredited institution and include your name, the institution name and confer date). Options: Some High School | High School or G.E.D. | Some College | Associates Degree | Bachelors Degree | Masters Degree | Doctorate Degree | None
02. Did you attach the required transcripts? Options: Yes | No
03. Select the career website you used to find this employment opportunity: Options: Sbccd.edu | Indeed.com | HigherEdJobs.com | EdJoin.org | CCCregistry.org | Other
04. Describe your experience in accounting and finance practices. Please include length of time.
05. Describe your experience in revenue projections, cost comparisons, and spending trends. Please include length of time.

06. Describe your experience with budgeting and financial management software. Please identify the specific software applications used, your level of proficiency, and the types of budgeting functions you performed.
07. Describe your experience working in finance at a PBS or NPR station. Please include length of time.

08. I hereby understand and declare that the statements on this supplemental questionnaire are true and complete to the best of my knowledge. As applicable, I hereby authorize the District and/or designees to contact the references listed to verify the information I have supplied. I hereby release from liability all persons and organizations furnishing such information. I understand that the District reserves the right to validate information received on the supplemental questionnaire and that I will be subject to disqualification and/or termination if any statement in this supplemental questionnaire is found to be untrue or determined to be misleading. Options: Yes | No
A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with major course work preferably in business, communications, marketing, broadcast and/or journalism.

In the absence of a Bachelor’s degree, an Associate’s degree or completion of sixty (60) semester units from an accredited college or university with major coursework in business, communications, marketing, media, broadcasting, journalism, or a related field, and five (5) years of increasingly responsible experience in public media, broadcasting, television, radio, digital media, production, station operations, or a closely related field, including at least two (2) years of lead, supervisory, administrative, or program coordination responsibility, is qualifying.

Three (3) years of increasingly responsible experience in public media, broadcasting, television, radio, digital media, production, station operations, or a closely related field, including at least one (1) year of lead, supervisory, administrative, or program coordination responsibility.
Ten(10) years of experience in accounting and finance practices
Ten(10) years of experience in revenue projections, cost comparisons, and spending trends
Experience with budget management software
Two(2) years experience working in finance at a PBS or NPR station
Television/radio/digital production and broadcast operations.
Coordinate and manage multiple concurrent station operations, projects, schedules, and production activities.
Principles of supervision, training and performance evaluation.
Supervise, train, schedule, and provide work direction to assigned personnel.
Principles and practices of budgeting and purchasing, expenditure tracking, and basic fiscal administration.
Coordinate effectively across programming, production, technical, digital, development, and administrative.
Principles and practices of satellite broadcasting procedures and protocols.
Apply established station, broadcast, brand, operational, and regulatory standards.
Principles and practices of program development and administration.
Analyze operational problems, evaluate alternatives, recommend solutions, and implement approved actions
Broadcast scheduling and On-Air procedures.
Exercise sound independent judgment within established policies, procedures, priorities, and delegated authority.
The resources, principles, and methods of researching program topics.
Adapt to changing operational priorities and meet critical deadlines in a fast-paced public media environment.
Principles and practices of the media industry and the nonprofit sector.
Interpret and apply applicable FCC regulations and other public media requirements related to assigned functions.
Station, workflows, systems and operating procedures and processes.

Demonstrate sensitivity to, and understanding of, the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students and personnel, including those with physical or learning disabilities.
Pertinent federal, state, and local laws, codes, and regulations; including
Demonstrate professionalism, fairness, and honesty in all aspects of the performance of duties.
FCC rules and regulations pertaining to station operations.
Develop interpersonal relationships with a diverse audience.
Public media licensing, reporting, public file, and compliance documentation requirements applicable to assigned station operations.
Promote an organizational culture that values creativity, open communication, diversity, and tolerance.
Digital, streaming, and emerging technologies.
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.
Office procedures, methods, and equipment including computers and media applicable software and media systems.
Plan and organize work to meet changing priorities and deadlines.
Meet critical deadlines while working with frequent interruptions.
Prepare clear operational reports, recommendations, schedules, records, and correspondence.
Working knowledge of print, online, digital, social, on-air production terms and processes.
Demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, general identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students.
